offering_description.value: Provides internet, phone and television services to households and businesses over fiber, cable and copper networks. It also owns and operates communications towers and leases space on them to wireless carriers and other network operators.

primary_services.value: broadband internet; phone service; television service; communications tower colocation

customer_segment.value: B2C: Households buying internet, phone and television service; B2B: Businesses buying connectivity and wireless network operators leasing tower space

end_markets.value: residential broadband and entertainment; business telecommunications; wireless network infrastructure

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring charges for internet, phone and television plans; rental or leasing: Long-term leases for antenna and equipment space at communications tower sites

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses fixed networks to deliver internet, phone and television to households and businesses; asset operator: Operates fixed communications networks and leases space on company-owned towers to wireless network operators

geography_served.value: US regional: Serves communities and operates tower sites across multiple U.S. regions, including the Midwest and Southeast

specialization.value: diversified: Fixed-line telecommunications for households and businesses, plus communications tower leasing for wireless network operators

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Residential and business sales teams and direct tower lease negotiations with wireless network operators; online: Address-based availability checks and residential service ordering through the broadband website

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Fixed-line phone service is subject to FCC and state utility rules, and tower sites face FCC and FAA requirements.

notes: The status of any remaining spectrum assets after the wireless service sale is uncertain.
